{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The essential role of groups in international development should be weighed in any revision of the tax code.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The advance of political freedom and entrepreneurial capitalism drives economic growth, catalyzes private sector development, and is the only sustainable solution to poverty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over the last 50 years, the level of private investment overseas from the United States has eclipsed aid many times over.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The development strategy must build on recent Republican efforts to use foreign assistance to catalyze private sector investment and expertise in addressing global challenges.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Using foreign assistance to catalyze private sector investment and expertise can build a more stable world and advance America's national security and economic interests.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The integrity of the country's foreign assistance program has been compromised by the current Administration's attempt to impose its own radical social agenda on foreign recipients, especially the peoples of Africa.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration excluded faith-based groups from foreign assistance because they will not conform to its radical social agenda.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Faith-based groups have the best track record in promoting development.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The party pledges to reverse the current Administration's course regarding foreign assistance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The party will encourage more involvement by the most effective aid organizations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Developing peoples should build their futures through their own values.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
